description:
ROLE AT A GLANCE

 - Level: Entry-level AI internship. Academic, personal, and internship projects count as experience.

 - Employment type: Part-time, temporary position. This is not a full-time or permanent role.

 - Location: In person in Berkeley, California. You must be able to work on site for your scheduled hours; this role is not remote or hybrid.

Please apply only if you are seeking a temporary, part-time role and can work in person in Berkeley. Weekly hours and assignment duration will be discussed during the interview process.



ABOUT TERRANOVA

Terranova is a hard-tech company combining mechanical engineering, robotics, automation, and field operations to solve real-world engineering challenges. We're looking for an entry-level AI Intern to help build practical tools that make our engineering and operations teams more efficient.


ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll work with engineers and operators to automate repetitive tasks, organize operational data, and prototype useful AI-powered tools. Projects will be scoped for a part-time, temporary assignment, with priorities and feedback from the team.

This is a hands-on opportunity for someone early in their career who has built working software projects and wants to apply those skills to physical engineering and field operations. The focus is practical implementation: useful scripts, integrations, dashboards, and internal tools.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and improve Python scripts and lightweight internal tools that reduce manual work.

 - Use LLM APIs and other AI tools to help teams find information and automate workflows.

 - Connect APIs, databases, and internal systems to make information easier to access and use.

 - Clean and analyze engineering and field data, including flow rates, pressures, material consumption, and ground uplift.

 - Create simple dashboards and reports to help the team track performance.

 - Test your work, document how to use it, and improve it based on feedback from engineers and operators.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Ability to work in person in Berkeley on a part-time schedule for a temporary assignment.

 - Working knowledge of Python and evidence that you can build and debug a useful script or application.

 - Some hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI tools, or workflow automation through coursework, personal projects, or prior work.

 - Basic familiarity with APIs, databases, SQL, or data analysis tools such as Pandas.

 - Willingness to work with messy real-world data, ask questions, and learn from feedback.

 - Clear communication, reliable follow-through, and interest in robotics, manufacturing, or field operations.

Extensive professional experience is not required. Please include a relevant project, code sample, or a brief description of something you've built.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building a simple web interface, dashboard, or internal tool.

 - Familiarity with time-series data, sensors, equipment telemetry, or applied machine learning.

 - Interest in mechanical systems, industrial automation, or engineering data.


WHY TERRANOVA?

You'll build tools that engineers and operators use in their daily work, get direct feedback from the team, and see how software and AI support real physical systems.
